notes: Cloudflare GraphQL CPU fields are in microseconds; summary converts to milliseconds.
Memory values are measured V8 isolate memory across invocations. They do not establish the peak within an invocation.
Cloudflare quantiles use reservoir sampling and can differ by a few bytes from an exact maximum due to quantile representation.
All requests were sequential. Cloudflare does not expose an isolate identifier here, so single-isolate affinity is not claimed.
The probe validates, decodes twice, compares, encodes a thumbnail, and encodes a full-sized mask for every request. The production comparator omits unchanged masks.
Probe performance.now() values and modeled RGBA byte totals are not used as resource measurements.
No request headers, credentials, IP addresses, or cookies were retained in tail evidence.
A first tail attempt rejected sampling-rate=1 before connection. The default-rate follow-up collected all ten events.
At collection time the API indexed fewer requests than the client received. The report preserves the exact indexed count; it does not fill missing measurements or treat them as zero.
